title: PetPace Vitals Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder cam detections, plant/soil sensors (`plant:sensor`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and plant sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=petpace:vitals
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(pet_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many PetPace vitals events land each day and how many distinct pet values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest PetPace vitals records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct pet values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It usefully how much PetPace vitals activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
